'''''Gorfan''''' was a pair of [[Modular conveyor]]s used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The conveyors were used to deliver supplies to help contruct a space station that would be called [[NL-1]] in the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]].
